citations.assessment: Yitzchak son of Tavlai appears in the two equivalent Yerushalmi chains, and the internal Yaakov Gevulaya notice names the same pair. These comparisons support the direction of filiation and distinguish the spellings; they leave historical identification with nearby Tavla entries open.

notes.text: The Hebrew calls Yitzchak his son, which the two Yerushalmi parallels independently support as a direction of filiation. The old author note reverses that direction and is preserved in the baseline record.
